sn55.22:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
sn55.22:1.3: atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn55.22:1.4: “idaṃ bhante, kapilavatthu iddhañceva phītañca bāhujaññaṃ ākiṇṇamanussaṃ sambādhabyūhaṃ.
sn55.22:1.5: so khvāhaṃ bhante, bhagavantaṃ vā payirupāsitvā manobhāvanīyaṃ vā bhikkhuṃ sāyanhasamayaṃ kapilavatthuṃ pavisanto
sn55.22:1.11: tassa mayhaṃ bhante, tasmiṃ samaye mussateva bhagavantaṃ ārabbha sati, mussati dhammaṃ ārabbha sati, mussati saṅghaṃ ārabbha sati.
sn55.22:1.13: “imamhi cāhaṃ samaye kālaṅkareyyaṃ kā mamassa gati, ko abhisamparāyo”ti?
sn55.22:2.1: mā bhāyi mahānāma, mā bhāyi, mahānāma,
sn55.22:2.2: apāpakaṃ te maraṇaṃ bhavissati, apāpikā kālakiriyā.
sn55.22:2.3: catūhi kho mahānāma, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro.
sn55.22:2.5: idha mahānāma, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.22:2.6: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.22:2.9: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.22:3.1: seyyathāpi mahānāma, rukkho pācīnaninno pācīnapoṇo pācīnapabbhāro, so mūle chinno katamena papateyyāti?
sn55.22:3.2: yena bhante, ninno yena poṇo yena pabbhāroti.
sn55.22:3.3: evameva kho mahānāma, imehi catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāroti.
